thaumcraft.configuration.allow_cheat_she: Enables a version of the Thaumonomicon in creative mode that grants you all the research when you first use it.
thaumcraft.configuration.allow_mirrors.t: Setting this to false will disable arcane mirror research and crafting recipes.
thaumcraft.configuration.allow_warded_st: If set to false, warded stone, doors and glass will just be cosmetic in nature and not have their hardened properties (everyone will be able to break them with equal ease).
thaumcraft.configuration.aspect_total_ca: The total amount of RP you can have in your pool per aspect before the scanning soft cap kicks in.
thaumcraft.configuration.biome_taint_fro: Can Taint be caused by flux effects.
thaumcraft.configuration.biome_taint_spr: The chance per block update (1 in n) of the Taint biome spreading. Setting it to 0 prevents the spread of Taint biomes.
thaumcraft.configuration.champion_mobs.t: Setting this to false will disable spawning champion mobs. Even when false they will still have a greatly reduced chance of spawning in certain dangerous places.
thaumcraft.configuration.color_blind.too: Setting this to true will make certain colors higher contrast or darker to prevent them from being invisible to color blind people.
thaumcraft.configuration.crooked.tooltip: Hate crooked labels, kittens, puppies and all things awesome? If yes, set this to false.
thaumcraft.configuration.display_aspects: Item aspects are hidden by default and pressing shift reveals them. Setting this to true reverses the behaviour and always displays aspects unless shift is pressed.
Can taint biomes generate at worldgen. Requires a game restart.
thaumcraft.configuration.glowing_taint.t: Setting this to false will remove the glowing purple nodules from taint fibres. This might improve performance. Reload chunks (F3 + A) to apply.
thaumcraft.configuration.golem_delay.too: How many ticks a golem waits between checking for tasks. Setting it higher will save server ticks, but will make the golems slower to react.
thaumcraft.configuration.hard_mode_nodes: Negative nodes like hungry, tainted or dark nodes will have additional, much nastier, effects.
thaumcraft.configuration.magical_forest_: Higher values increase the number of magical forest biomes. Requires a game restart.
thaumcraft.configuration.node_rarity.too: How rare nodes are in the world. The number means there will be (on average) one node per N chunks.
thaumcraft.configuration.notification_de: Determines how fast notifications scroll downwards, in milliseconds.
thaumcraft.configuration.notification_ma: The maximum amount of notifications that are displayed on screen.
thaumcraft.configuration.research_diffic: 0 = normal, -1 = easy (all research items are directly purchased with RP), 1 = hard (all research items need to be solved via the research table).
thaumcraft.configuration.runic_cost.tool: How much aer and terra centi-vis (0.01 vis) it costs to recharge a single unit of shielding.
thaumcraft.configuration.runic_recharge_: How many game ticks pass after a shield has been reduced to zero before it can start recharging again.
How many milliseconds pass between runic shielding recharge ticks. Lower values equal faster recharge.
thaumcraft.configuration.shaders.tooltip: This setting will disable certain Thaumcraft shaders for those who experience FPS drops.
thaumcraft.configuration.special_node_ra: The chance of a node being special (pure, dark, unstable, etc.). Roughly 1 in N nodes will be special.
thaumcraft.configuration.taint_biome_wei: Higher values increase the number of taint biomes. Requires a game restart.
thaumcraft.configuration.title: %s Configuration
thaumcraft.configuration.wand_dial_botto: Set to true to have the wand dial display in the bottom left instead of the top left.
thaumcraft.configuration.wuss_mode.toolt: Setting this to true disables Warp and similar mechanics. You wuss.
